task: Explain A0 replay and diagnose why 298 strict samples changed from wrong to correct
root_cause: A0 rebuilt context from all raw_memories instead of replaying the saved baseline context_str_full. This added memories, especially preference memories omitted from the original displayed context. Generation and judge nondeterminism are secondary contributors.
conclusion: The current A0 is not a valid exact baseline replay, so stable_wrong and downstream flip claims are confounded and should be rerun using the byte-identical saved baseline context.
